[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Nancy was born in 1817. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1189|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-1190|Elizabeth Glasgow]].  She passed away in 1904. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1189]] is assessed at 49% (possible). The 1850–1900 census and children’s death references support Nancy Glasgow Rood’s later identity but do not reproduce her own father’s name. Her 1817 birth fits the Robert/Elizabeth family, yet the Michigan-to-Martinsburg parent bridge remains an inherited assertion.

Whole selected father-profile proposition; maternity and upstream ancestry assessed separately.

Next useful test: Read Nancy’s 1904 Michigan death certificate for her own parents.

Source basis already held: [http://seekingmichigan.org.
